newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Westpac says margins under pressure.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Westpac says margins under pressure.

text.p: Westpac Banking Corp said on Tuesday that its bad debts charge in the 1995/96 year ended September 30 fell to A$121 million from A$330 million.
The major Australian bank said in a statement accompanying its annual result that margins remained under pressure in all units. It also said higher fee income was the key to future profit rises.
"Interest rate margins remain under pressure across all businesses in Australia and New Zealand," the bank said.
"Looking forward, competition is expected to remain intense," it said, adding that it would continue to focus on maintaining the appropriate balance between asset growth and pricing for risk.

"In such an environment, maintenance of overall net earnings growth will depend increasingly on attaining improvements in fee income generation, particularly non lending-related fees and on improved efficiency of operations," Westpac said.
